outcome: Recovery semantics are ratified and coherent: operational failures retry within budget without a human ritual, verdicts are never healed, one paid model execution per work per epoch is an enforced invariant, workspace scratch never enters a candidate, and the conformance suite pins exactly these behaviors.

exclude: healing or retrying any verdict failure
changes to receipt schemas or the trust rules themselves

acceptance.text: An absent or operationally-failed previous attempt is retryable within the epoch's try budget, and never-retried derived work follows its first writer's epoch; the wedge classes that killed runs r9 through r12 stay dead, evidenced by the existing regression tests.

A work with any succeeded try in an epoch admits no further tries in that epoch: the guard scans all recorded tries, not only the immediately previous one, so a refused try's missing effect cannot re-open payment. Fresh chances come from epoch bumps that mint fresh work.
The seal deletes workspace tmp/ before staging, so scratch never enters a candidate; the existing regression test pins it.

The four conformance pins that asserted the old semantics now assert the ratified ones with boundedness explicit: bounded operational retry may heal and merge where re-execution is safe, a succeeded dispatch is never re-paid within its epoch, and every retry sequence terminates within the try budget.

constraints: The reference diff projected as input is the commitment for the recorded portions; the single-payment guard and the four pin revisions are new work within this scope.
Verdict failures are never retried, healed or superseded by recovery; only operational failures are.
Retry budgets bound every sequence; no path may retry without consuming a try.
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository; the candidate diff carries only product changes.
